findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now still returns `true`. Any caller relying on this function can therefore expose documents across tenant boundaries. Restore the tenant equality check.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported document label contract
findings.body: Consumers comparing or serializing the exported label now receive `"Document record"` instead of the established `"Document"` value. This changes the public constant’s observable contract despite the PR’s stated intent to preserve existing contracts.

findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant equality authorization check
findings.body:
Every mismatched `userTenant`/`documentTenant` pair now returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document access and potential data disclosure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported document label contract
findings.body:
Consumers expecting the established exact value `"Document"` now receive `"Document record"`, breaking serialized output, equality checks, and snapshots that use this exported API constant.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body:
Any request where `userTenant !== documentTenant` is now authorized because the function unconditionally returns `true`, enabling cross-tenant document disclosure for every caller relying on this access check.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
